document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  var lazyloadImages = document.querySelectorAll("img.lazy");    
  var lazyloadThrottleTimeout;
  
  function lazyload () {
    if(lazyloadThrottleTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(lazyloadThrottleTimeout);
    }    
    
    lazyloadThrottleTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
        var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset;
        lazyloadImages.forEach(function(img) {
            if(img.offsetTop < (window.innerHeight + scrollTop)) {
              img.src = img.dataset.src;
              img.classList.remove('lazy');
            }
        });
        if(lazyloadImages.length == 0) { 
          document.removeEventListener("scroll", lazyload);
          window.removeEventListener("resize", lazyload);
          window.removeEventListener("orientationChange", lazyload);
        }
    }, 20);
  }
  
  document.addEventListener("scroll", lazyload);
  window.addEventListener("resize", lazyload);
  window.addEventListener("orientationChange", lazyload);
});
</script>

<script language="JavaScript" type="text/JavaScript">
String.prototype.contains=function( str ) {
	return new RegExp(str,"i").test(this); 
}

function hidePromoTable(childObj,tagName) {
    if(document.title.indexOf('Shipping Method') != -1){
        var testObj = document.getElementById(childObj);
        var testObj = testObj.parentNode;
        var count = 1;
        var tablecount = 0;
        while(tablecount <= 1) {
            testObj = testObj.parentNode;
            count++;
	        	if(testObj.tagName == tagName){
			tablecount++;
	    	}
        }
        // comment the line below to unhide the promo code box on the Shipping page of checkout
        testObj.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function findUPSText() {
	var str = "United%20Parcel%20Service%20of%20America";
	var nodes = document.getElementById("div__body").getElementsByTagName("td");
	
	var flag = false;

	for(i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) {
		if(nodes.item(i).className == "text") {
			if ((nodes.item(i).innerHTML).contains(unescape(str))) {
				flag = true;
				var a = nodes.item(i);
				a.innerHTML = "";
				var b = document.createElement('div');
				a.appendChild(b);
				b.innerHTML = "UPS®, UPS & Shield Design® and UNITED PARCEL SERVICE® are registered trademarks of United Parcel Service of America, Inc.";
				
				//nodes.item(i).innerHTML = "<center>UPS®, UPS & Shield Design® and UNITED PARCEL SERVICE® are registered trademarks of United Parcel Service of America, Inc.</center>";
			}	
		}
	}
        hidePromoTable('kReferralCode','TABLE');
}
</script>

<div class="free-ship-top-left free-ship-top-box"><strong>FREE Ground Shipping</strong><br/>On orders over $100</div>

<div class="free-ship-question">How do I get Free Ground Shipping?</div>
<div class="free-ship-answer">You get free shipping anywhere in the contiguous 48 states on all orders of $100 or more. There are no added processing or handling fees!</div>
<div class="free-ship-question">What is flat rate shipping?</div>
<div class="free-ship-answer">Pay only $6.99 to ship any order under $100 - no added processing or handling fees!  Applies to ground service anywhere in the contiguous US.</div>
<div class="free-ship-question">What about shipments to Alaska and Hawaii?</div>
<div class="free-ship-answer">Rates begin at $6.99 and will not exceed $19.99, regardless of order size.  Expedited shipping options are available for an additional charge.</div>
<div class="free-ship-question">What if I need my order fast?</div>
<div class="free-ship-answer">Choose UPS 2nd Day Air with rates starting at $13.99. You'll find even faster shipping options and estimated shipping fees displayed in the shopping cart.</div>
<div class="free-ship-question">Do you ship internationally?</div>
<div class="free-ship-answer">We do. Our <a href="/shipping-policy">Shipping Policy</a> gives details on shipments to international destinations. Free Shipping and Flat Rate Shipping only apply to destinations within the United States.</div>
<div class="free-ship-question">Questions?</div>
<div class="free-ship-answer">For more information about our Save on Shipping program, check our complete <a href="/shipping-policy">Shipping Policy</a> or call Customer Service at <a href="tel:8882232545" rel="nofollow">(888) 223-2545</a>.</div>

<script type="text/javascript">
function printListingPage(){
  var isSafari = Object.prototype.toString.call(window.HTMLElement).indexOf('Constructor') > 0;
  if(!isSafari){
  	var checkListingPage = jQuery('.sbs_item_cell').length;
  	if(checkListingPage > 0){
	  jQuery('body').addClass('printingDoc');
	  jQuery('#pageContent').after('<div id="printedDiv"></div>')
	  var contentArr = '';
	  jQuery('.sbs_item_cell').each(function(){
	    var getContent = jQuery(this).html();
	    getContent = getContent.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
	    getContent = '<div class="sbs_item_cell">'+getContent+'</div>';
	    contentArr += getContent; 
	  });
	 
	  jQuery('#printedDiv').html(contentArr);
	  jQuery('.sbsListHeader').clone().prependTo('#printedDiv');
	  jQuery('#printedDiv').prepend('<div id="listing-header-container"></div>');
	  jQuery('#listingHeader').clone().prependTo('#listing-header-container');
	  jQuery('table#pageContent > tbody > tr.portletHandle > td > table > tbody > tr > td > table > tbody > tr:first-child > td > table > tbody > tr > td:first-child > table').clone().prependTo('#listing-header-container');
	  jQuery('.bgbutton.custom-print-button + table > tbody > tr:first-child').clone().prependTo('#printedDiv');
	  jQuery('#printlogo').clone().prependTo('#printedDiv');
	  
	  jQuery('#printedDiv').appendTo('body');
	  window.print();
	  jQuery('#printedDiv').remove();
	  jQuery('body').removeClass('printingDoc');
	} else {
		window.print();
	}
  } else {
    window.print();
  }
}

<h2>Traditional by Design</h2>
<h1>Reproducing historic antique hardware since 1999</h1>
Our carefully curated collection of period-inspired hardware and lighting spans styles from <a href="/colonial-hardware">colonial</a> to <a href="/mid-century-hardware">mid-century modern</a>. These beautiful, functional, and authentic pieces aren't just for the restoration purist -  they are for all those who value quality design and traditional craftsmanship. Whether you are renovating your kitchen with new <a href="/cabinet-drawer-pulls">knobs and pulls</a>, deciding on the perfect <a href="/antique-chandeliers">antique-style chandelier</a>, or updating <a href="/antique-door-hardware">door hardware</a> throughout your home, you’ll find inspiring options for every room.
